title: Yara and the Alibi
author: Lena Underhill
blurb: Sebastian Reyes, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
